title: Rally match state diagram
description: The phase of one Rally match. newMatch(seed) starts in serve, and only step() changes the phase. The paddles move in every phase.

states.description: The ball rests on the server's paddle for SERVE_DELAY.
The ball is in play, sub-stepped so it can't pass through a paddle.
The pause after a point, POINT_PAUSE.
A side has at least 11 points and leads by two; step() changes nothing more.

transitions.action: serve(): launch at SERVE_SPEED with a random slope; rally = 0; emit serve.

transitions.trigger: step(): the ball crosses a paddle's face
transitions.action: returnBall(): steeper off-centre and 6% faster; emit paddle.

transitions.trigger: step(): the ball leaves the table
transitions.action: The other side scores; timer = POINT_PAUSE; emit point.

transitions.trigger: step(): the ball leaves the table
transitions.action: winner = that side; emit point and win.
server = serverFor(score, firstServer); timer = SERVE_DELAY; rest the ball.
